title: Halting detection under reciprocal-time decaying torus forcing
exact_target: At fixed positive computable viscosity, can every machine and input be effectively encoded into smooth mean-zero forcing on $T^3$ with $||partial_t^j$ $D_x^\alpha $ $f(t)||_infinity\leq C_{j,\alpha }(1+t)^{-1}$ for every derivative order, and a unique zero-data global smooth Navier–Stokes solution of uniformly bounded kinetic energy, while a fixed particle enters a fixed open set exactly if the machine halts?
